scope: One CPU diagnostic of an anchored bridge-trained frozen proposal; not a posterior sampler or scientific measurement.
wall_cap_semantics: Check after each completed likelihood call, never convert budget exhaustion to a rejected proposal. An individual in-flight call can exceed the budget; use an external timeout with separate grace for a hard process cap. Preserve all partial requests/records.
native_initialization: One explicit unchanged native_initialize before target evaluations, recorded separately from successful surrogate fallback spectra.
proposal: Unchanged FrozenMixture normalized Gaussian/t5 draws and logpdf. Freeze all400 requests and uniforms before model construction. Complete audited anchored bridge training only; no adaptation or retuning from pilot outcomes.
initialization: First finite independent proposal draw; pre-initialization failures are retained and count toward400. Every subsequent rejected proposal retains the previous occupied state once.
transition: logalpha=min(0,logp(y)-logp(x)+logq(x)-logq(y)). Compare independent log uniform to logalpha, with no candidate clipping or support redraw.
reporting: Descriptive acceptance, finite-target fraction, holding concentration, candidate raw importance ESS and noisy fixed-coordinate ESS only. No posterior mean/interval, model preference, significance, convergence qualification or automatic production adoption.
prerequisites: Current complete anchored scaffold validation; genuine complete bridge and frozen proposal provenance verified by anchored_proposal.load; unchanged target identity, all data/prior sources and numerical runtime. No provisional or synthetic input may enter the real-pilot action.
limits: A short single-chain diagnostic can miss modes and estimate ESS poorly. Heavy-tailed draws can trigger slow exact spectrum fallback. A budget stop is an incomplete diagnostic, not a valid target rejection or failed scientific hypothesis. Native accuracy1/2 labels describe the eventual correction target; this pilot evaluates only the declared accuracy-one numerical proposal.
